senses.gloss: (denom. of קֵן) to build a nest, to nest. Y. Peah VII, 20ᵇ top; Keth. 111ᵇ, v. לֶפֶת.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14">Cant. R. to II, 14</cite> <he>ומצא … מְקַנֵּן</he> and found there a serpent nesting; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְקוּנָּן</he>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 62">Yalk. Gen. 62</cite> (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37:4">Gen. R. s. 37</cite> <he>מְכוּנָּן</he>), v. <cite ref="K00859"><he>כָּנַן</he></cite>.
